layer_3_action.subject: An open coastal margin of the ancient Tethys Ocean
features: White chalky cliffs and marl shorelines
Vast, calm marine waters with deep blue hues
Occasional phosphatic sandbars reflecting the sun
Sargassum-like floating kelp mats near the shore

visuals.ground: Soft white chalk and grey marl. High phosphate content gives sand a yellowish-grey tint.
visuals.water: Deep, clear marine water with high nutrient content (plankton rich).

strata_specifics.ground_texture: Soft chalk, marl, and phosphatic limestone.
